answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. What survives to the falcon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A willow of per-task receipts records who did what, and the terrace of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
